title: finding(docs): `content/docs/fields/lookup.mdx` says `SelectOptionSchema` refuses `description` with a 422, but the installed spec 17.4.0 declares and accepts it
body:
Filing-gate category: ② published prose that no longer matches the contract it describes, with a named site, measured. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat #2 (`session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`). The source is the objectui#10755 dev report (PR objectui#10766, comment `5855205558`). The at-tier contract review of that PR confirmed it by its own measurement. ⛔ Not graded here.

## The site

`content/docs/fields/lookup.mdx` (the published page `/docs/fields/lookup`), lines 68 to 76 on objectui `origin/main` `63835d998f`. The paragraph tells authors four things:
- `SelectOptionSchema` is "strict over exactly {label, value, color, default, visibleWhen}";
- it "refuses `description` by name (`unrecognized_keys`)";
- authoring it "fails the whole field with a 422";
- a `description` "must never reach authored object metadata".

## Measured

Two parties measured this on the installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.4.0 (the `./data` export): the dev, and the PR objectui#10766 contract review.
- `SelectOptionSchema`'s keys are `color, default, description, label, value, visibleWhen`.
- An option with `description` is ACCEPTED, and so is a select `FieldSchema` carrying it.
- The control, `icon`, is REFUSED with `unrecognized_keys`, so the instrument is live.

Spec 17.3.0 declared the key (the maintainer's ruling on objectui#6140 / objectui#6153, option A). PR objectui#9588 (`544ecba84f`) moved the five shipped docblocks off the refusal. `packages/types/src/__tests__/select-option-spec-extension-7014.test.ts` pins the moved boundary. This page was left behind.

The paragraph's citation now points at `0e3b3be09`, the landing commit PR objectui#10766 re-cited it to. That commit dates the claim to its spec 17.2.0 measurement; the claim is false of the installed spec today.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Rewrite the paragraph to the installed contract:
- `description` is declared on `SelectOptionSchema` and accepted;
- `LookupField`'s typeahead searches `option.description` (`packages/fields/src/widgets/LookupField.tsx`, per the dev report);
- an unknown option key such as `icon` is refused.

Frontmatter unchanged. Docs only, so no changeset.

## Dedupe

Read by REST: every open objectui issue, and the 1000 most recently updated items (back to 2026-09-20). Matched against `lookup\.mdx`, `SelectOptionSchema … description` and `description … unrecognized_keys`. Hits:
- objectui#10755 and PR objectui#10766 (this finding's source);
- objectui#7650, about the object-schema serve path's strictness, not this page.

No card.

Dedupe words: `lookup.mdx description unrecognized_keys stale` · `SelectOptionSchema description 422 docs` · `option description spec 17.3.0 declared docs`
